title: Call brief
description: The one-time, per-call payload. Everything specific to THIS call and never reused. Layers one and two of the prompt (persona and conduct) are fixed and live in src/voice_notifier/prompt.py, not here.

brief_id.description: Opaque handle. This is what travels in the TwiML custom parameters — the brief itself never goes over the wire to Twilio.

tier.description: 0 = announcement (no LLM in the call path). 1 = conversational.

name.description: The person Claude is acting for. Spoken in the greeting of every call.

recipient.description: Must resolve to an allowlist entry. `key` is the allowlist lookup; `number` is checked against it and the call is refused on mismatch.

relationship.description: Prompt material — it sets the register and vocabulary, not just the tone. Tier 1 only.

language.description: BCP-47. English only for now — see D11.

greeting.description: Spoken immediately on answer, before the recipient says anything. This is where the AI disclosure goes, and it is mandatory in effect: if omitted, one is generated. Tier 1 uses it as ConversationRelay's welcomeGreeting.

message.description: The thing being conveyed. Written to be spoken, not read. Front-load the point; no lists, no parentheses; times as a person would say them.

anticipated_questions.description: Pre-authorised answers. Anything not here gets 'I don't know — contact <operator> directly'. A question that is really a request to pass a message on gets the answer REFUSAL.

answer.description: Free text, or a string beginning with REFUSAL to route to the fixed no-message wording from the conduct layer.

prohibitions.description: Negative constraints for THIS call, on top of the standing ones in the conduct layer. Each should be a specific thing a helpful model would otherwise volunteer.

closing.description: How to end, so the agent does not improvise a goodbye.

caps.description: Hard turn and duration limits. Enforced by the relay server, not by the prompt.

voicemail.description: What to say if a machine answers. Always present — a tier 1 call degrades to a tier 0 announcement.

text.description: Required when leave_message is true. Must identify Claude as an AI, same as a live greeting would.

_comment.description: Ignored by the tooling. Present so worked examples can explain themselves.
